prompt: Here is a new pull-sync module (evals/fixtures/pull-sync/server/src/modules/pull-sync/). It re-fetches files and commits of a PR from GitHub. QA saw a PR in the UI with zero files after a GitHub timeout during sync. Review the module and tell me what to change — root cause plus anything else structurally wrong you see. Write the concrete fix.

assertions.text: Identifies the non-atomic delete-then-insert of pr_files/pr_commits (+ pull update) as the root cause of the empty PR
Moves all GitHub calls before the writes, so no external call happens inside the transaction
Wraps the writes in a single transaction
The transaction is opened through a port (UnitOfWork / uow.run or equivalent) so the service does not import drizzle or db/client; repository methods accept a tx scope
Flags getPull(prId) as not scoped by workspaceId
Flags listStale / syncStale as not scoped by workspaceId (re-syncs other workspaces' PRs)
Flags openFindings / the findings route as not scoped by workspace (reviews.workspaceId missing, route ignores context)
Flags raw db rows (PullRow / FindingRow) leaking out of the repository/service to the HTTP response, or the missing response schema
Proposes a test that proves rollback or that a failed GitHub fetch leaves the old files intact
